title: The 8 Best Workbench Vise 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for workbench vise 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at workbench vise 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Wilton Woodworking Vise, 4" x 10" Pivot Jaw, 13" Jaw Opening (Model 79A)
products.blurb: Key specs: Pivoting front jaw (10 degrees), 13-inch jaw opening, Metal housing fully encloses the screw.
strengths: Pivoting front jaw holds irregularly shaped and tapered workpieces square
13-inch jaw opening handles thick stock and wide panels most vises can't
Enclosed screw housing keeps sawdust and dirt from gumming the threads
Rapid-acting mechanism speeds up repeated open and close cycles
limitations: Larger and heavier than a standard 7-inch vise -- needs a sturdy bench
features: Metal housing fully encloses the screw
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Dremel 2500-01 Rotary Tool Multi-Vise, 3-in-1 Attachment
products.blurb: Key specs: 360-degree rotation base, 50-degree tilt adjustment, Steel jaw construction.
strengths: Rotating and tilting head holds oddly shaped workpieces at angles a standard bench vise can't match
3-in-1 design works as a stationary vise, stand-alone clamp, or rotary tool holder
Soft protective jaw pads included for delicate workpieces
Precise, repeatable positioning for carving, small parts, and fine detail work
limitations: Small jaw capacity compared to a full-size bench vise -- not a replacement for a main face vise
Designed around Dremel rotary tool use, though it works as a general small-parts vise too
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Yost L65WW Hobby Wood Working Vise
products.blurb: Key specs: 6.5-inch jaw width, Cast iron body, Wood-lined jaws.
strengths: Cast iron body at a price close to import bench vises meant for metalworking
Wood-lined jaws protect workpieces from metal jaw marring
Adequate holding power for general joinery and assembly work
The correct first vise for a shop bench where a premium is not justified

Not as refined as premium leg vise hardware in fit and finish
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money
